one_sentence: The post-Flood lifespan decline in Genesis 11 follows a quantum decoherence equation with an asymptotic floor, implying grace prevents total collapse.
executive_summary: This document establishes a structural isomorphism between quantum decoherence and the post-Flood patriarchal lifespan decline in Genesis 11. The core claim is that lifespans decay exponentially with a nonzero floor, mirroring how a quantum system loses coherence but retains a residual due to persistent external coupling. Key evidence includes an exponential+floor fit (R²=0.888, p=4.73×10⁻⁷) that outperforms five alternative models, and four independent convergences on the floor value (93 years from regression, 70-80 from Psalm 90:10, 73-82 from modern WHO data, and 120 as a ceiling from Genesis 6:3). The conclusion is that this isomorphism is Level 3 (structural), with bidirectional consequences: physics predicts a floor in lifespan decay, and theology predicts a coherence source (grace) preventing total collapse. The document also includes six kill conditions for falsification.
